description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeReportController within the OrangeHRM system. It manages the logic for rendering employee report views and list components, utilizing services like ReportGeneratorService to retrieve report data based on request attributes.

classes.name: EmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering employee report views within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService used to generate reports.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering, using request attributes to determine whether to display a specific report view or a list view.
